mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pmis_finance_payment WHERE payment_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pmis_finance_payment SET status = #{status}, confirmed_by = COALESCE(#{confirmedBy}, confirmed_by), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE pmis_finance_payment SET invoice_allocation = #{allocation}, allocated_amount = #{allocatedAmount}, unallocated_amount = #{unallocatedAmount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pmis_finance_payment WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY payment_date DESC
SELECT * FROM pmis_finance_payment WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY payment_date DESC
SELECT * FROM pmis_finance_payment WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND status = 'CONFIRMED' AND unallocated_amount > 0 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY payment_date ASC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(allocated_amount), 0) FROM pmis_finance_payment WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'ALLOCATED') AND deleted = 0

SELECT TO_CHAR(payment_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM pmis_finance_payment WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'ALLOCATED') AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(payment_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month

SELECT customer_id, customer_name, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM pmis_finance_payment WHERE status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'ALLOCATED') AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY customer_id, customer_name ORDER BY amount DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(allocated_amount), 0) FROM pmis_finance_payment WHERE status = 'ALLOCATED' AND deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(allocated_amount), 0) FROM pmis_finance_payment WHERE status = 'ALLOCATED' AND deleted = 0

SELECT TO_CHAR(payment_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM pmis_finance_payment WHERE status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'ALLOCATED') AND deleted = 0 AND payment_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TO_CHAR(payment_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT #{limit}
